description: If the native first-order calculus derives \(\psi\) from \(\varphi\), a sentence using only their shared nonlogical symbols factors this into native derivations \(\varphi\vdash\theta\) and \(\theta\vdash\psi\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CraigInterpolation.deductive_interpolation.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (φ ψ : L.Sentence) (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives {φ} ψ) :
  ∃ θ,
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols θ ⊆
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols φ ∩
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols ψ ∧
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives {φ} θ ∧
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives {θ} ψ
